findings.title: Reflected XSS via `name` parameter — filter bypass with double quotes
findings.description: The `/page` endpoint reflects the `name` GET parameter directly into the HTML page without sanitization. A keyword blacklist blocks `script`, `onerror`, `onload`, and single-quotes (`'`), but allows `ontoggle` event handler with double-quote delimited strings. Payload: `<details open ontoggle=alert("XSS")>` bypasses all filters and executes arbitrary JavaScript. The server validates the XSS execution and returns the CTF flag upon success.
